correctness.rationale: The regular semisimplicial word complex generated by all even permutations has every word of length <=n-1: inserting the omitted symbol in alternate positions yields both parities. Thus its (n-2)-skeleton equals that of the full injective-word complex, supplying (n-3)-connectivity. Independently built all signed cellular boundary matrices in the literal subsequence bases, verified integer d^2=0, computed ranks and exact SymPy Smith factors: n3 top [1^3], n4 [1^11,2], n5 [1^56,2^4], with corresponding lower-boundary ranks [2,3], [3,9,12], [4,16,44,60]. The n=3,4,5 full reduced groups follow, with no n>=6 extrapolation.

value.rationale: The alternating groups A4 and A5 are canonical permutation generator subsets, and exact first nonzero integral homology with one and four 2-torsion factors is a natural, reusable finite classification beyond rational Betti numbers and beyond general free-pi1 results. It discriminates sharply between subgroup-generated word complexes, quotients, and shellable pattern-avoidance classes.
